obligations.requirement: PointerTrace serializes confirmed, predicted, timing, pressure and lifecycle metadata with a stable schema.
obligations.oracle: Independent schema assertions over fixed corpus fixtures.
obligations.acceptance: All required fields and version are exact; malformed and duplicate sequences are rejected.

obligations.requirement: The same confirmed PointerTrace produces the same replay digest and StrokeRecord candidate on every run.
obligations.oracle: Reference digest captured from fixed fixture, compared field-for-field without implementation-generated expected values.
obligations.acceptance: Ten consecutive replays and alternate batch chunking match exact digest and points.

obligations.requirement: Cancel, prediction correction, confirmed overrun and surface-metrics generation changes never create a partial canonical candidate.
obligations.oracle: Independent cases with explicit expected disposition/counters and no candidate after cancel/invalid generation.
obligations.acceptance: Every lifecycle case passes and state remains unchanged on rejection.

obligations.requirement: The corpus covers straight, circle, sharp-turn, pressure-ramp, pressure-unavailable, slow/fast, long-60s, cancel, prediction-correction, confirmed-overrun and surface-metrics-generation-change.
obligations.oracle: Corpus manifest enumerates each case and runner reports each case independently.
obligations.acceptance: No required case is omitted; each has an exact expected digest or rejection outcome.
